decisions.reason: As a newly launched product close to the core offer and already given its own webpage, it carries enough sunk cost and visible commitment that management would likely keep it and attribute any weak start to a normal ramp-up period.

Although it is more distant from the established offer and less central to the stated strategic direction, the recent launch and stand-alone web presentation still create enough investment and justification pressure for management to continue with it for now.
This product line is close to the firm's base business, involves several models, and has been publicly presented in its own right, so escalation of commitment strongly favors staying the course.

The supplement supports the firm's push into differentiated self-care products, and despite the lighter public commitment on the website, management would likely keep it because it fits the announced direction and can still be seen as early-stage.
